title: Airlift Kailas Cleanup Campaign
description: High-altitude drone logistics and environmental reconnaissance at Mt. Manaslu.
fullText: The Airlift Kailas Cleanup Campaign (September 4–27, 2025) advanced high-altitude drone logistics and environmental reconnaissance at Mt. Manaslu (8,163 m). Deliverables include detailed terrain mapping, validated operational envelopes, and geospatial datasets for autonomous logistics missions in extreme environments.
